title: lupinus albicaulis var. elatus
intro: Lupinus albicaulis var. elatus, commonly known as Elate Lupine, is a variety of the Lupinus albicaulis species, a flowering plant in the legume family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful for soothing skin irritations and protecting against cellular damage. The therapeutic actions of Elate Lupine are believed to be attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
